xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2270: Review pipeline strands strike-originated PRs: auto-review trigger and pan review restart/request all require workspaces/feature-<id>

plan.title: Review pipeline strands strike-originated PRs: resolve strike workspace + branch at every review-dispatch site
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: A strike agent works in workspaces/feature-<id>-strike on branch strike/<id>; pan done opens a PR against strike/<id>. Every review-dispatch path then hardcodes the branch as feature/<id> (deacon-review-status.ts) or feature/<numeric> (review-control.ts). Because the branch is wrong, the review agent (1) fails the fast mergeability check when it cannot resolve the PR via `gh pr view feature/<id>` (review-agent.ts:495-513), and/or (2) runs `git diff origin/main...HEAD` in a workspace whose HEAD is not the strike tip and produces nothing, then exits. The review status never records a verdict (stays pending/pending). The deacon orphan reconciler sees `reviewing` with no active review agent, resets to pending, re-dispatches with the same wrong branch, and thrashes (RUN-53: review live at 00:33, gone by 00:53, three times). review-control.ts is worse: getWorkspaceInfoForIssue (workspaces.ts:412) does not even know the -strike suffix, so `pan review restart --rerun` resolves a non-existent workspace dir. The manual unblock today is `pan workspace create PAN-<id>` + `pan review restart`, both requiring a human.
narratives.Proposal: findAllWorkspacePaths already resolves the strike workspace (candidate #2, archive-planning.ts:53) — the workspace path is not the problem in the deacon paths. Introduce one pure helper, inferBranchFromWorkspace(workspacePath, issueLower), in archive-planning.ts: returns `strike/<id>` when the path ends in `-strike`, else `feature/<id>`. Apply it at all FOUR spawnReviewRoleForIssue sites in deacon-review-status.ts so the review agent gets the correct branch. Fix review-control.ts separately: resolve the workspace via findWorkspacePath (which includes -strike) instead of the -strike-blind getWorkspaceInfoForIssue/feature-<numeric> fallback, and derive the branch strike-aware while preserving its existing non-strike convention. Update the review-agent architecture doc. This makes strike-origin PRs reviewable without any manual workspace materialization.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT auto-create a workspaces/feature-<id> directory (the manual workaround); the root-cause fix removes the need for it.
- Do NOT change findAllWorkspacePaths / findWorkspacePath ordering; the -strike candidate is already present and feature-first ordering is deliberate.
- Do NOT add or change any orphan-reaper / patrol reaping logic; the RUN-53 reap-thrash is a symptom of the branch/workspace mismatch and is fixed by resolving both correctly.
- Do NOT unify the two feature-branch conventions (deacon's feature/<id> vs review-control's feature/<numeric>); only redirect the strike case, leaving each site's existing non-strike branch string untouched.
- Do NOT change getWorkspaceInfoForIssue itself; review-control switches to findWorkspacePath instead.
- Do NOT change the best-effort reviewedAtCommit path in reconcileReviewStatusOrphan (line ~457); it is non-fatal and out of scope.
- Do NOT change the auto-trigger event flow that fires when a strike first creates its PR; this issue covers the re-dispatch, restart, and patrol paths only.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept scope to the branch/workspace resolution at the four deacon dispatch sites + review-control, and diagnosed the RUN-53 reap-thrash as a symptom rather than adding orphan-reaper changes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The title names exactly these dispatch/restart/patrol paths. isReviewAgentActiveForIssue matches by issueId+role independent of workspace, so a correctly-dispatched strike review is detected as active — the thrash disappears once dispatch resolves the right workspace+branch. Adding reaper changes would be speculative scope beyond the verified root cause.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixed all FOUR deacon spawnReviewRoleForIssue sites, not the three the pre-existing PRD draft listed.
autoDecisions.rationale: grep found a fourth hardcoded feature/<id> branch in the stalled-review-convoy recovery path (~line 757). Leaving it unfixed would strand strikes that hit that recovery path.

autoDecisions.summary: Expanded review-control's fix from branch-only (as the draft said) to workspace+branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: getWorkspaceInfoForIssue does not know the -strike suffix, so a branch-only fix would still resolve a non-existent workspace directory for strike issues.

narrative.Action:
In src/lib/cloister/deacon-review-status.ts, extend the archive-planning import (currently `import { findWorkspacePath } from '../lifecycle/archive-planning.js';`, ~line 20) to also import `inferBranchFromWorkspace`. Then replace the hardcoded branch argument at ALL FOUR spawnReviewRoleForIssue call sites. At each site the resolved `workspace` variable (from findWorkspacePath / agentState?.workspace) is already in scope; use it:

- Site 1 — handleReviewCoordinatorDied (~line 381): `branch: \`feature/${issueLower}\`` → `branch: inferBranchFromWorkspace(workspace, issueLower)`.
- Site 2 — pending re-dispatch in reconcileReviewStatusOrphan (~line 540): same substitution; `workspace` is the resolved var at line ~532.
- Site 3 — stalled review convoy recovery (~line 757; workspace resolved at ~line 680): same substitution. THIS IS THE SITE THE OLD DRAFT MISSED — do not skip it.
- Site 4 — checkMissingReviewStatus (~line 846; workspace resolved at ~line 830): same substitution.

Grep to confirm zero remaining `branch: \`feature/${issueLower}\`` occurrences in this file after the edits. Change ONLY the branch argument value at each site — no other logic. Do not modify the reviewedAtCommit path (~line 457).

narrative.Action:
In src/dashboard/server/routes/workspaces/review-control.ts, fix the rerun re-dispatch block (~lines 302-318). Today: `wsPath = wsInfo.localPath || join(resolved.projectPath, 'workspaces', \`feature-${numericSuffix}\`)` and `branchName = \`feature/${numericSuffix}\``. Because getWorkspaceInfoForIssue is -strike-blind, wsInfo.localPath is undefined for strike issues and the fallback dir does not exist.

Changes:
1. Add import: `import { findWorkspacePath } from '../../../../lib/lifecycle/archive-planning.js';` (join the existing import block).
2. Resolve the workspace via findWorkspacePath, which includes the -strike candidate, falling back to the current feature-<numeric> join only if it returns null:
   `const wsPath = wsInfo.localPath || findWorkspacePath(resolved.projectPath, issueLower) || join(resolved.projectPath, 'workspaces', \`feature-${numericSuffix}\`);`
3. Derive the branch strike-aware WITHOUT changing the existing non-strike convention:
   `const branchName = wsPath.endsWith('-strike') ? \`strike/${issueLower}\` : \`feature/${numericSuffix}\`;`
   (Keep the `feature/${numericSuffix}` string for the non-strike case exactly as-is per hazard H1 — do NOT switch it to feature/<id>.)
Leave the spawnReviewRoleForIssue call otherwise unchanged (it already passes issueId, workspace: wsPath, branch: branchName, prUrl).

After findWorkspacePath is added to the review-control.ts imports, `npm run typecheck` passes and `npm run lint` passes
